I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. The boundaries to the block of land with the following names and extents, indicated in detail in the progression tracing as bearing number B/ACQ/BDL/2016/66 dated 24.04.2017 prepared by the Surveyor General which is situated in the village of Malwatte village (within Badulla Municipality) of Badulupitiya Division No. 8 coming under Badulupitiya (78J) Grama Niladhari Division in Rilpola Korale Minor Division of Badulla Divisional Secretary's, Division in Badulla District in the Province of Uva:

01. Lot A – Mudunpita Magulliyadda - Extent: 0.0665 Hectare North: Mudunpita Magulliyadda claimed by Rambukpotha Raja Maha Viharaya; East: Mudunpita Magulliyadda claimed by Rambukpotha Raja Maha Viharaya and Road; South: Road; West: Road and Mudunpita Magulliyadda claimed by Rambukpotha Raja Maha Viharaya. Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/4/2015/LO/21.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.30th October, 2023.
